notes.title: The Future Of The Forgotten
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been a long time since I have updated this game etc. I just wanted to give you some information about the future of this game.

As of right now, I have it planned that I am going to do a rework for this game. The reason for this is because over the years I have become much much better at everything to do with gamedev, I have become a better programmer, have more resources, knowledge on how to optimise games etc etc.

[b]So, I will admit, the re work will be far into the future as right now my priority's are as follows
[/b]
[b]- Finish developing Unknown Presence + Support for the game + extras (This is the new game)
- Finish the remake I'm doing on my other previous title "The Entity"
- And then I will work on the rework for The Forgotten.[/b]

So, my new game comes out in July, so the remake for The Entity will be by the end of the year, so the rework for this game will probably be early 2025. I know this is a very long time in the future, but I wanted to communicate it with you all as I am really wanting this games experience to be good for everyone, and I am aware of the numerous issues this game has.

Thank you all very much and I really hope you all are excited for this even though it's ages away! :)

[b]Hello everyone[/b],
I know it has been a while since the last update, that's due to me being unsure on things to add and the stuttering issue really took me this long to figure out a way to fix/work around.[i][b](There will still be small stutter when enemies spawn in due to the nature of this work around but that will reduce the stutter from 100% of the time to around 10% of the time and I am continuing to work on this issue)[/b][/i]
There will still be more updates in the future as well as I still plan on fixing/adding/changing a bunch of things. 

[b]Anyway, here are the update notes for this small update (V1.09)
[/b]
- Have changed the moss/grass texture that is on top of rocks

notes.title: Important Update Information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to let you all know that I am still working on The Forgotten and am working on getting an update finished. It may be a little longer until the new update as I am trying to fix majority of the issues. For a start the main thing I’m trying to make work better is enemy and animal AI systems (specifically enemy) to try and make them feel more alive and meaningful. 

I am also working on some performance improvements and just overall issue fixes and making systems a bit more polished. I’m a one man team working on this so it may take a bit for the next update but it will be a good update that should alleviate many of the issues and problems! 
I look forward to seeing what you all think when the new update is published!

Thank you all for being honest in reviews and patient so far! :)

notes.title: Language Issues Release
notes.content:

Just a bit of an update on the issues the game is having with the languages. So there's good and bad news, the bad news is that I have to re-do around 40% of the games dialogue/texts to make the languages be able to work which means I am having to push the release to March 3rd to allow time to actually re do it all.
[b]The good news[/b] though is that I am able to fix the language issues which I am so happy about, as I don't want to have the game in only English!

notes.title: Development Log 4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

- For the past 2 weeks or so we have been working on trying to fix a few major optimisation issues within a few areas. We are still unsure what is causing it but we are getting closer to finding out why, we hope to have this issue fixed as soon as possible.
- We are also working on a few AI issues where they are unable to path correctly, we are working on this issue and trying to get it working.

- Other than those issues we have added in another 2 area locations[New screenshots will show at least one of them] into locations that didn't feel "full".
- And we have been adding new sounds to the game to give it more of a real life feeling and to make it give you more of the sense of fear while going through the map. 


We will be posting 3 new screenshots and a few of the current ones will be getting updated tomorrow so keep and eye on the store page tomorrow for more of a look into what The Forgotten will look like!


Thank you all!
Regards, Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Development Log 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

CHANGES

Currently we are working on finishing up all Steam control implementation (Achievements etc). We are also working on adding the last dozen or so scripts into the game and then will to begin to test those and make sure everything is working as it should do.

And lastly we are still doing some optimization and editing textures and object meshes to make them perform better then what they currently are so that lower end pcs can handle the game on a higher quality.
